title: Modernizing society: railways, ports and immigrants
goal: Read how railways, ports and immigration changed Latin America in the late 19th century, and use the gerund to say what happened at the same time.

items: Use the gerund to say what two actions were happening at the same time.
Say what the railways carried and where they went.
Say where European immigrants arrived from the 1870s.
Say who did not benefit equally from modernization.
Use the key words of this lesson: railway, telegraph, to export, British, meat, nitrate, agricultural and immigration.
